scope: Publishes the verified deterministic standard-calibrated IQ2_XS/Q2_0 GGUF shard set to the explicit RESMP-DEV Hugging Face model destination, following the organization's GGUF model-card format and recording upload integrity.

authorization.user_instruction: Models should always be uploaded to https://huggingface.co/RESMP-DEV; make this artifact public with a sufficient disclaimer and a better name.

repository.model_card_format: Aligned with RESMP-DEV/MiMo-V2.6-Distill-Qwen-9B-GGUF: base-model metadata, status, scope disclaimer, at-a-glance table, file table, usage, calibration/conversion, validation, reproducibility/integrity, and credits.

model_card.roundtrip: PASS: final README.md, provenance.json, and SHA256SUMS downloaded from the public repository and compared byte-for-byte

lfs_upload.method: Authenticated main machine issued short-lived multipart LFS actions; Strix uploaded presigned parts and recorded per-part ETags. No Hugging Face account token was installed on Strix.
lfs_upload.resume_state: Every completed part and ETag was persisted; an early progress-report bug was corrected and the controller resumed without reuploading completed parts.

pointer_repair.detail: A first raw-pointer experiment exposed 136-byte pointer blobs. The pointers were replaced through the normal legacy-LFS commit path with the already completed OIDs; Xet was disabled for that commit.

lfs_upload.signed_action_cleanup: All local and remote generated LFS action JSON files were deleted after completion; zero remain.

checks.name: metadata-roundtrip
checks.command: hf download README.md provenance.json SHA256SUMS; cmp against source

checks.name: lfs-parts
checks.result: 2,000 of 2,000 parts completed and both LFS completion requests passed

checks.name: public-lfs-identity
checks.command: ranged GET on both public shard URLs
checks.result: HTTP 206, complete logical content ranges, and linked SHA-256 etags matched

checks.name: old-personal-repository-cleanup
commands: list old repository files and assert no GGUF was present

non_claims: Ranged public requests and Hub LFS OIDs verify storage identity without re-downloading all 66.65 GB.
The model card's one-token execution result is not a quality or general-throughput claim.
The calibration corpus and importance matrix remain private.
The final public shard files are the previously tensor-payload-verified split; no new quantization was performed for publication.
